summary: After E opens the stylus getobj prompt, the ? help menu is one row shorter in JS. C places a Miscellaneous heading before the fingertip extra choice because sortpack is active; JS begins with the fingertip item and omits that header. The row-0 M-versus-dash mismatch and one-row cursor shift identify invent.c:display_pickinv(), not wand engraving behavior.

source.branch: In the E command, engrave.c:doengrave() calls getobj("write with", stylus_ok, GETOBJ_PROMPT); stylus_ok(NULL) suggests hands, so getobj() handles ? by passing getobj_hands_txt() as display_pickinv() extra choice. With sortpack active, C invent.c:display_pickinv() inserts a "Miscellaneous" heading before the extra fingertip item. The current JS display_pickinv() usextra branch adds the item without that conditional heading, shifting the whole menu up one row.
callers: C path: engrave.c:doengrave() -> invent.c:getobj() question-mark branch (1963-1981) -> invent.c:display_pickinv(); stylus_ok(NULL) admits hands and the C screen shows the inventory class headings.
JavaScript path: js/engrave.js:doengrave() -> js/invent.js:getobj() question-mark branch (1197-1221) -> js/invent.js:display_pickinv(); its usextra branch currently inserts only the fingertip item.
dependencies: Preserve the flags.sortpack condition and menu item order: C adds the Miscellaneous heading before HANDS_SYM only when the hands/fingertip item is an extra choice, then continues with the existing inventory class headings.

The caller supplies xtra_choice through getobj_hands_txt() because stylus_ok(NULL) returns GETOBJ_SUGGEST; keep that separate from actual inventory objects and use the existing add_menu_heading()/select_menu path.
The missing heading changes screen row placement and the terminal cursor by one line; preserve the existing inventory contents, selectors, selection behavior, and RNG order.

evidence: Saved challenges/evaluations/20260926132731-v6.json and the current queue report 1 remaining screen out of 17; first mismatch at segment 0 step 16, key "?": row 0 column 31 is "M" in C and "-" in JS, cursor C [37,12,1], JS [37,11,1]. Before it, 16/17 screens, 2465/2465 RNG calls, and 16/17 cursors.

challenges/cases/v6/wizard-engrave-wand-menu.session.json: Its final C screen starts with the highlighted "Miscellaneous" heading at row 0 and "- - your fingertip" at row 1, then shows Weapons, Rings, Wands, and Tools headings. The JS screen is one row shorter at the first difference, with "-" where the C heading begins.

nethack-c/upstream/src/engrave.c:481-491 has stylus_ok(NULL) return GETOBJ_SUGGEST, and doengrave() calls getobj("write with", stylus_ok, GETOBJ_PROMPT) at 977. nethack-c/upstream/src/invent.c:1963-1981 routes ? through getobj_hands_txt() to display_pickinv().

nethack-c/upstream/src/invent.c:3253-3260 explicitly adds the "Miscellaneous" menu heading before HANDS_SYM when flags.sortpack is set. The case screen’s following Weapons/Rings/Wands/Tools headers confirms that this sortpack menu branch is active.

js/invent.js:1197-1221 reaches display_pickinv() with the hands text; js/invent.js:2005-2007 adds the usextra hands row without the corresponding Miscellaneous header. This missing source branch explains both the one-cell content difference and the one-row cursor shift.
